gravitax.map.description: The lava world map with the World Bank castle in the middle, the camera creeping toward it; no monster, sign or HUD.

gravitax.squad.description: The World Bank window grows into the squad picker, the cursor picks a squad card and moves toward Attack (clipped before the press).

burnedText: squad cards show combat power numbers (mock)
Attack button label
World Bank window chrome (tab bar, Leader tab)
boss HP numbers and an Ends-in countdown (mock values)

gravitax.swing.description: Gravitax swings his sword in front of the World Bank window and the guardian health bar drops on impact.

burnedText: World Bank window chrome (tab bar, Leader tab)
boss HP numbers and an Ends-in countdown (mock values)

gravitax.target.description: The World Bank window pops open over the lava map with the Gravitax guardian health bar draining and Gravitax himself rising in front.

burnedText: World Bank window chrome (tab bar, Leader tab)
boss HP numbers and an Ends-in countdown (mock values)

leaderboard.countdown.description: One cream rank card on the lava castle swaps player by player from #10 to #8, each avatar, name and point total sliding in from the right while the points count up.

leaderboard.podium.description: The rank card moves from #4 to #3 to #2, each swap sliding the next player's avatar, name and points in while the card grows slightly bigger.

number-one.description: The rank card swaps to the #1 player at its biggest size and the camera slowly pushes in on that player's avatar while the points count up.

leaderboard.poster.description: The Critters Quest wordmark over the dimmed lava World Bank castle while a loop of glowing shards bursts up and toward the camera.

burnedText: Critters Quest wordmark logo

raid.march.description: A red line draws between two towns on the world map and a squad walks along it, the camera creeping in.

raid.send.description: The raid panel opens over the blurred map, the cursor picks Squad 1 and a loot token, presses Send Raid, and the panel turns into a marching card and shrinks away.

burnedText: raid panel labels (Loot Tokens, Select Squad, Send Raid, Travel / arrives, Squad 1 marching)
squad chips show combat power numbers (mock)
mock town names and levels (Stonebrook, Maplewood)

raid.target.description: A slow push-in on the world map as the cursor slides in and taps a rival town; no HUD.

raid.warning.description: A red incoming-raid banner drops with a countdown while the attacking squad walks toward the defender's town and the cursor taps Set defense.

burnedText: banner text: Incoming raid on Maplewood, Squad 1 from Stonebrook (CP 1,240), arrives in countdown, Set defense / Shield now

shards.contest.description: A claimed red-glow shard on the dimmed lava map while a rival squad of four round critter tokens marches in and a comic bubble says the contest is queued.

burnedText: comic bubble: "Queued contest! The fight resolves when you land."

shards.cracks.description: Crystal shards burst out of the cracked World Bank dome toward the camera over the lava map while two comic bubbles say the bank has cracked and shards have scattered.

burnedText: comic bubbles: "Gravitax has been defeated!" and "The bank cracked and shards have scattered across the map!"

shards.map.description: The lava world map with three glowing shard markers around the World Bank castle while the cursor glides to the middle shard and clicks it.

burnedText: shard progress bars with amounts
map sign with boss HP and pool
HUD resource pills and timers (mock values)

shards.season.description: The Season 2 shard leaderboard opens over the blurred castle, rows sliding in one by one and the points counting up before the player's own row highlights.

burnedText: Season 2 leaderboard: rank, points, pool and shard counts (mock names)
tab and header labels

titans.attackPick.description: The Floranix Titan window swings open on its Attack tab while a squad card is picked and the rounds step up to five as the camera pushes in.

burnedText: Titan window text (HP, pool chip, fee line, Attack button with QUEST fee; mock values)

titans.attackSend.description: A tilted low-angle sweep over the Titan window settles flat, the cursor clicks ATTACK and the button shows sent, then the cursor opens the Leader damage board.

burnedText: Titan window text (HP, pool chip, fee line, Attack button with QUEST fee, board pool line; mock values and mock wallets)

titans.wake.description: The world map with the World Tree Sanctum and Floranix the Titan standing awake on it, the camera creeping in and the Titan timer chip ticking in the top corner.

burnedText: Map HUD (profile button, wood/stone/coal pills, mini map, World Bank chip, Titan chip with HP % and timer; mock values)
